submission.notes: The court's Self-Help Center page (/self-help/self-help-center) returned a 403. The Phone & Fax Numbers page lists 510-267-6911 for 'Clerk's Office (Unlawful Detainers, Small Claims, Civil Restraining Orders)'. It appears under the Family Division heading, which looks like a page layout quirk, and it is the same number listed for the Civil Division clerk. The Self-Help Center number 510-272-1393 is on the same page. The site also had a banner saying the eCourt public portal is temporarily unavailable. I did not fetch any official page about form SUM-130.
